name: substrait
description: Build and deploy apps on the Substrait platform from Claude Code. Bundles the substrait-app skill (scaffold apps to the upload/deploy contract) plus /substrait:init to initialize a folder as a Substrait project (scaffold from empty, or convert an existing codebase), /substrait:login to authenticate your Substrait account (each login is a saved profile), /substrait:switch to pick which saved login — installation and org — the machine acts under, and /substrait:logout to sign one out again, /substrait:link and /substrait:deploy to connect a local project to a Substrait app and ship it without leaving the terminal, /substrait:env to manage the app's environment variables and secrets, /substrait:logs to read a deployed app's runtime logs when it misbehaves in production, /substrait:fix to clear the app's Dev blocking security findings (fix the code, file false-positive claims with Infosec, redeploy), and /substrait:library to browse the platform's API Library, design apps against existing APIs, and — with development access from the API's data owner — call them read-only from the editor to see real responses, and /substrait:slate to create, change, pull and push back Substrait slates — AI-made documents, decks and interactive pages — from the editor.

portal_url.title: Substrait portal URL
portal_url.description: Base URL of your Substrait installation, e.g. https://app.substrait.build. Optional: you can also pass --portal-url to /substrait:login. There is no default — Substrait is multi-tenant, so a wrong default would silently target the wrong installation.
